name: Wave Racers
hook: Jet skis, big waves, buoys. Miss one: +2 seconds.
how: Race jet skis three laps around the islands on a rolling sea. Steer between every pair of buoys, fly off the wave crests and keep your line; each missed gate adds 2 seconds to your time.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D to steer, Down or Space to brake into tight turns, or on-screen buttons
uses: The fastest three-lap races, penalties included.
The host's browser starts each race and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots race the line, and now and then miss a gate, until enough people join.
Every jet ski rides the same waves for everyone at once.
ideas: Make the waves bigger and add a storm
Add boost rings floating between the gates
Turn it into a night race with glowing buoys
